title: Atlas DataFlow Training Parameter Record
description: Five schema-version-discriminated profiles are supported: training-parameter-record.v1 (unchanged -- the reduced provenance artifact emitted by a governed M24 training run under pipeline/training-runs/{dataset_slug}/{run_id}/training-parameter-record.json, linking the consumed execution contract and prepared dataset to the produced model and metrics artifacts using SHA-256 hashes), training-parameter-record.v2 (Project Spec S0216, Atlas-native fixed-configuration multiclass training provenance, carrying explicit fixed-finalization protocol evidence and a governed multiclass classification_evidence claim), training-parameter-record.v3 (Project Spec S0224, Atlas-native fixed-configuration continuous-regression training provenance, mirroring v2's fixed-finalization protocol evidence with a governed continuous-regression regression_evidence claim in place of classification_evidence), training-parameter-record.external-fitted-model.v1 (Project Spec S0157, describing an already-fitted external model's parameters/provenance from a validated handoff/projection flow, binary-classification-oriented), and training-parameter-record.external-fitted-model.v2 (Project Spec S0208, the same external-handoff profile generalized to a multiclass classification_evidence claim in place of v1's binary positive-class ownership). None of the five profiles embed raw dataset contents, model bytes, raw logs, raw runtime data, raw API payloads, secrets, or notebook state.

schema_version.description: Schema version for the training parameter record artifact.

record_kind.description: Identifies this artifact as the provenance and parameter record for a governed training run, not as the training metrics artifact.

training_run_identity.description: Identity of the training run that produced this record.

dataset_slug.description: Stable dataset slug used to parameterize the training run path.

run_id.description: Training run identifier using the train-{timestamp}Z convention.

output_directory.description: Concrete output directory for this run, derived from pipeline/training-runs/{dataset_slug}/{run_id}/.

consumed_inputs.description: Reduced references to the governed training inputs. The dataset_id values must match before training proceeds.

execution_contract_path.description: Explicit path reference to the execution_contract.v1 JSON consumed by the training entrypoint.

dataset_path.description: Explicit path reference to the prepared dataset consumed by the training entrypoint.

execution_contract_dataset_id.description: dataset_id read from the execution contract.

prepared_dataset_dataset_id.description: dataset_id read from the prepared dataset metadata. Must match execution_contract_dataset_id.

produced_outputs.description: Reduced path references to artifacts produced by the same training run. M24-03 produces the serialized model and this parameter record only; metrics and model-card input remain later issue responsibilities.

serialized_model_path.description: Path to the serialized model artifact. The default interface convention is model.pkl, but the role remains stable if a future serializer changes the extension.

training_parameter_record_path.description: Path to this reduced training parameter record artifact.

metrics_path.description: Path to the distinct training metrics artifact. Null for M24-03 because metrics production is owned by M24-04.

model_selection_evidence_path.description: Path to conditional model selection evidence. Null when no multi-candidate comparison was performed.

model_card_input_path.description: Path to reduced model card input data. Null for M24-03 because model-card input production is owned by M24-05.

training_timestamp.description: UTC timestamp when the model artifact and training parameter record were produced.

serializer.description: Serializer metadata required for future inference runtime compatibility checks.

serialization_format_version.description: Versioned serialization format identifier recorded from the installed serializer.

controlled_entrypoint_provenance.description: Structured marker generated by the controlled training entrypoint. This marker is required so notebook-originated or ad hoc model artifacts cannot be accepted as governed pipeline outputs.

generated_at.description: UTC timestamp from the controlled training entrypoint.

marker_id.description: Non-static digest derived from controlled entrypoint inputs, run identity, and timestamp.

permitted_execution_contract_fields.description: Closed list of execution contract fields actually consumed by the training run. Must match the M24 training interface subset and must not include ignored_columns, required_columns, or optional_columns. Project Spec S0108 added result_semantics as an authorized, optional consumed field used to resolve the governed positive class.

training_parameters.description: Reduced parameter values selected from the permitted execution contract fields for reproducibility and audit. This record intentionally does not include ignored_columns, required_columns, or optional_columns.

hyperparameters.description: Reduced JSON-safe hyperparameters used by the fitted estimator.

binary_classification_evidence.description: Project Spec S0108: governed binary-classification evidence for the selected model, or null when the fitted model is not binary. Never embeds raw predictions or evaluation rows.

ordered_class_labels.description: The fitted model's actual classes_ ordering, so a reversed class order is recorded as evidence rather than hidden.

hashes.description: SHA-256 hashes linking the consumed inputs and serialized model output for this training run. The training parameter record hash is computed after this file is written and is reported by the caller because embedding it would change the bytes being hashed.

execution_contract_sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the execution contract JSON file consumed.

prepared_dataset_sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the prepared dataset file consumed.

model_artifact_sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the serialized model artifact produced.

metrics_sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the metrics.json artifact when produced by M24-04. Null or absent for M24-03.

record_boundary_confirmations.description: Boundary confirmations for the parameter record artifact.

is_metrics_artifact.description: This parameter record is not the metrics artifact.

unauthorized_contract_fields_consumed.description: No execution contract fields outside the permitted M24 training subset were consumed.

controlled_entrypoint_provenance_marker_.description: The governed training entrypoint generated and recorded a controlled-entrypoint provenance marker.

evidence_policy.description: Safety policy for the training parameter record.

internal_run_record_v2.description: Project Spec S0216: Atlas-native fixed-configuration multiclass training provenance, emitted alongside training-metrics.v2 at pipeline/training-runs/{dataset_slug}/{run_id}/training-parameter-record.json. Carries explicit fixed-finalization protocol evidence (no model selection ever occurred) and a governed multiclass classification_evidence claim sourced from the real fitted final model's own classes_ attribute.

model_selection_evidence_path.description: Project Spec S0216: fixed-configuration multiclass training performs no model selection, so this is always null -- never a path.

split_policy_v2.description: Project Spec S0216: a real three-way native multiclass split. Unlike split_policy (shared with v1, whose val_ratio may be 0), val_ratio must be strictly positive here -- a governed multiclass fixed-configuration run always produces a real, non-empty validation partition.

internal_run_record_v3.description: Project Spec S0224: Atlas-native fixed-configuration continuous-regression training provenance, emitted alongside training-metrics.v3 at pipeline/training-runs/{dataset_slug}/{run_id}/training-parameter-record.json. Carries explicit fixed-finalization protocol evidence (no model selection ever occurred) and a governed continuous-regression regression_evidence claim.

model_selection_evidence_path.description: Project Spec S0224: fixed-configuration continuous-regression training performs no model selection, so this is always null -- never a path.

split_policy_v3.description: Project Spec S0224: a real three-way native continuous-regression random split. Unlike split_policy (shared with v1, whose val_ratio may be 0), val_ratio must be strictly positive here -- a governed continuous-regression fixed-configuration run always produces a real, non-empty validation partition.

external_fitted_model_record_v1.description: Project Spec S0157: parameter/provenance record for an already-fitted external model, from a validated handoff/projection flow. Never requires an Atlas training run ID, controlled-entrypoint provenance marker, or Atlas training output directory, and never embeds model bytes or raw partitions.

handoff_lineage_reference.description: Reference into the validated external handoff/projection lineage. Never an Atlas training-run path.

estimator_identity.description: Bounded structured estimator identity. Never an arbitrary module import path or callable string.

hyperparameters.description: JSON-safe selected hyperparameters. Never model bytes.

preprocessing_evidence_reference.description: Reference to preprocessing evidence. Preprocessing is never executed here.

positive_class_id.description: Present only when the fitted model is binary. Preserved without raw labels or predictions.

serializer_metadata_reference.description: Reference to serializer metadata from the validated handoff lineage. Never embeds model bytes.

model_state_fingerprint.description: Semantic fingerprint of the fitted model's state. Must be consistent with the same fingerprint recorded in the corresponding external model-selection-evidence and, when present, inference-bundle evidence.

atlas_fit_confirmation.description: Explicit confirmation that Atlas did not fit, tune, recalibrate, or alter this model.

external_fitted_model_record_v2.description: Project Spec S0208: v2 external fitted-model training-record profile. Preserves every S0157 external-handoff invariant established by v1, but carries a governed multiclass classification_evidence claim in place of v1's binary positive_class_id/positive_class_probability_index/binary_classification_evidence ownership. Never requires an Atlas training run ID, controlled-entrypoint provenance marker, or Atlas training output directory, and never embeds model bytes or raw partitions.

handoff_lineage_reference.description: Reference into the validated external handoff/projection lineage. Never an Atlas training-run path.

model_family.description: Project Spec S0208: bounded external scientific candidate vocabulary, generalized from v1's single hist_gradient_boosting-only family to the same four scikit-learn family/class pairs already accepted by the external model-selection contract.

estimator_identity.description: Bounded structured estimator identity. Never an arbitrary module import path or callable string. The library/class_name pairing is cross-checked against model_family below.

hyperparameters.description: JSON-safe selected hyperparameters. Never model bytes.

preprocessing_evidence_reference.description: Reference to preprocessing evidence. Preprocessing is never executed here.

serializer_metadata_reference.description: Reference to serializer metadata from the validated handoff lineage. Never embeds model bytes.

model_state_fingerprint.description: Semantic fingerprint of the fitted model's state. Must be consistent with the same fingerprint recorded in the corresponding external model-selection-evidence and, when present, inference-bundle evidence.

atlas_fit_confirmation.description: Explicit confirmation that Atlas did not fit, tune, recalibrate, or alter this model.

external_family_estimator_pair_v2.description: Project Spec S0208: closes the v2 model_family/estimator_identity pairing so a cross-paired combination (e.g. model_family=random_forest with class_name=LogisticRegression) is rejected.

multiclass_classification_evidence_v2.description: Project Spec S0208: governed multiclass classification evidence claim about the external fitted model -- not proof from model deserialization. Basic types/minimums/uniqueness are enforced here; the exact class_id/probability_index sequencing (probability_columns[i].probability_index == i and probability_columns[i].class_id == ordered_class_ids[i]) is enforced defensively by the materializer.
